summary.text: Blair Eddins is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 94 since October 1, 2024, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Eddins earned a bachelor's degree from North Carolina State University in 1995.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as an auditor, small business owner and farmer, and says that as of 2024 he worked for Samaritan's Purse.
He took office in 2024, succeeding Jeffrey Elmore, a fellow Republican.
